column1: # The licence texts each package carries, pinned per upstream release (review round 46 PR-MED-031):
# <UPSTREAM_TAG> TAB <path in the source archive> TAB <sha256>. check-artefacts.mjs requires each package's LICENSE.txt
# and LICENSE-UPSTREAM.txt to be byte-equal to the archive's LICENSE_GPL.txt and LICENSE.txt, and those to hash to the
# row for the lock's tag. At a rebase, a new tag has no row and the build is refused: read both texts in the new tree
# (and docs/licence-facts.md's record of them), then add the tag's two rows. No upstream text is committed here.
